rules.problem: Type, trigger and coverage match the red box (RR and SBP are routine vitals). Minor: footnote 1 ('If SBP < 80, pulse >= 100, RR > 30, confusion/restlessness, weakness, shock likely') is not encoded as a probable shock rule; Shock is only a recorded finding.

rules.problem: Nothing invented, but the page's 'malaria area in past 3 months, consider malaria' and 'If on abacavir, check for AHR' have no checked finding and no rule; the diphtheria pseudomembrane drops 'bleeds easily if touched'.

rules.rule: Diagnose probable meningitis from fever page
rules.problem: 'Likely' on the page, so probable is right; the flat OR follows the comma/slash list. Purple/red rash is narrowed to purple only (see c045).

rules.rule: Diagnose probable appendicitis from fever page
Diagnose possible mpox from fever page
rules.problem: 'Consider' maps to possible; the and/or structure (lesion group AND >= 1 of the symptom group) is faithful. Only the 'unexplained' qualifier is lost.

rules.rule: Diagnose possible diphtheria from fever page
rules.problem: 'Consider' maps to possible; the structure is faithful. The 'bleeds easily if touched' qualifier is dropped.

'Likely' maps to probable and the evidence is right, but the diagnosis concept is too narrow: South African tick-bite fever (Boutonneuse/R. conorii) excludes African tick bite fever. Use Spotted fever group rickettsial disease. The page's gate ('if none of the above, or previous malaria test/s negative') is not encoded.

rules.rule: Diagnose probable acute viral infection from fever page
rules.problem: No branch (no tick bite/tick) AND any of headache/body pain/recent common cold is faithful. As with tick bite fever, the upstream 'none of the above / malaria test negative' gate is not encoded, so a febrile patient with headache from a malaria area gets probable viral infection before malaria is excluded.

rules.rule: Urgent: fever with red-box danger signs
rules.problem: Urgent is justified by 'Give urgent attention'. Every red-box criterion is present, and meningitis/appendicitis go through active_condition per house style.

summary: Nothing is invented and every rule type, trigger and priority level matches the page. The tick-bite fever diagnosis uses 'South African tick-bite fever' (Boutonneuse), which is narrower than the page's generic tick bite fever and excludes African tick bite fever; 'Spotted fever group rickettsial disease' fits. The page's 'consider malaria' (malaria area in past 3 months) has no possible-malaria rule and no checked finding, and the 'none of the above / malaria test negative' gate before the tick/viral branches is not encoded. Smaller precision losses: the purple/red rash is narrowed to Purpuric rash only (add Non-blanching rash), the 3-day fever window is dropped, and the unexplained (mpox) and bleeds-on-touch (diphtheria) qualifiers are lost.
